name: get_properties_at_time
title: Read properties at a time
description: Read many properties of many layers at one time in a single call, e.g. [{layer:'Title', properties:['Position','Opacity']}, {layer:2, properties:['Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness']}]. Errors are reported per property.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: list_essential_properties
title: List Essential Properties
description: Without layer: list the Essential Graphics controllers of a comp. With layer (a precomp layer in comp): list that instance's Essential Properties with their current values.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: set_essential_property
title: Set Essential Property
description: Set an Essential Property value on one precomp layer instance (by name or 1-based index), e.g. change the title text or color of one use of a template comp.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

value.description: Value: number, array ([x,y] / [x,y,z]), color, string (Source Text) or object (shape path / text style).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: add_to_essential_graphics
title: Add to Essential Graphics
description: Expose a property of a layer in its comp's Essential Graphics panel (optionally with a custom name) so precomp instances can override it.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: list_fonts
title: List fonts
description: Search installed fonts; returns PostScript names to use in text tools (AE 2024+).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: get_selection
title: Get selection
description: What the user has selected in AE right now: active comp, playhead, selected layers and properties. Great for 'animate this layer' requests.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: select_layers
title: Select layers
description: Select layers in the timeline (empty list clears the selection).

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

items.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: begin_undo_group
title: Begin undo group
description: Start grouping the following calls so ONE undo call reverts them all (e.g. 10 calls that build one idea). Closes automatically after 120 s without calls or at the next begin_undo_group. After Effects' own Ctrl+Z still undoes one call at a time.

name: end_undo_group
title: End undo group
description: Close the open undo group. The next undo call without steps reverts every call of the group.

name: undo
title: Undo / redo
description: Undo or redo the last After Effects steps. Every MCP call is a single undo step; right after end_undo_group, undo without steps reverts the whole group.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: execute_menu_command
title: Run menu command
description: Execute an AE menu command by id or (English) menu name, e.g. 'Fit to Comp', 'Center Anchor Point in Layer Content'.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: run_extendscript
title: Run ExtendScript
description: Escape hatch: run custom ExtendScript in After Effects. Code is a function body; use `return` to send back a value (comps/layers/properties are serialized). `AEMCP` helpers (getComp, getLayer, resolveProp, color...) and `args` are available. Disabled when AE_MCP_DISABLE_EVAL=1.

parkViewer.description: Show a tiny empty comp in the viewer while this runs (much faster for heavy changes to an open comp); the viewer is restored afterwards, also on error.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: batch
title: Batch operations
description: Run several tools in ONE round trip and ONE undo step, e.g. create 10 layers and animate them. Each operation is {tool, args} using the same names/args as the individual tools (AE-side tools only). If an operation fails the call returns isError with failed/stoppedAt; operations before the failure STAY applied (one undo step: call undo to revert all) unless atomic:true, which reverts the whole batch automatically. Batches over 20 operations temporarily move the viewer off the comp (2-3x faster); in big comps prefer chunks of ~100 operations.

atomic.description: Revert every operation if any fails.

parkViewer.description: Default true: hide the comp from the viewer while a 20+ operation batch runs.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).
